sections.label: Header
sections.description: Branding and navigation in the top bar.

fields.label: Brand name
fields.description: Used when there is no custom logo and in the footer.

fields.label: Main menu
fields.description: Choose an existing WordPress menu, or use automatic product categories.

fields.label: Mobile bottom navigation
fields.description: Show the bottom navigation on mobile. When disabled, search, cart and account appear in the header, as on desktop.

fields.label: Show gallery thumbnails
fields.description: Show selectable thumbnails below the product gallery. Swipe remains available.

sections.label: Footer
sections.description: Compact, one-line copyright and legal links.

fields.label: Footer note
fields.description: Optional short note inline with the brand on desktop. Hidden on narrow mobile screens to keep one row.
